text:
aj: heads-up — apiserver reconnections spiking across eu-west1 control planes for ~12m. GPU attach flows are timing out or retrying. anyone seeing correlated cp noise?
meera: noticed it. digging into etcd compaction logs and cp node iowait. grabbing samples.
aj: posting traces and metrics. TLS handshakes failing and controller-manager losing leader leases.
sre-bot: [alert] APISERVER_CONN_RECONNECT_RATE high on eu-west1-cp. Incident INC-5678 created and assigned to oncall-ops.
oncall-ops: ack, i'm on it. link to incident: https://redwood/incident/INC-5678
meera: logs show compaction started then nvme queue latency spike immediately after. sample logs:
```
May 14 09:11:02 etcd[1]: starting auto compaction at revision 2_344_872
May 14 09:11:03 kernel: nvme2: I/O 4532 Q2 timeout, rq 0x7f8a
May 14 09:11:04 apiserver: http: TLS handshake error from 10.12.3.4: remote error: tls: internal error
May 14 09:11:05 controller-manager: leaderelection: failed to renew lease: timed out
```
tony: NVMe iowait would stall etcd wal writes which blocks apiserver writes / leases. that matches the controller-manager leader flips.
kate: immediate mitigation idea: throttle compaction or move compaction window off-peak. can someone reduce compactor throughput?
meera: reducing compactor throughput now (compactor.io_rate_limit=0.4). applying to cp shard 2 only as canary.
meera: applied. monitoring.
oncall-ops: after throttle, apiserver reconnects dropped from ~180/min to ~12/min over 60s. GPU attach median latency improved 6.8s -> 1.1s.
aj: good quick win. but root cause looks like compaction scheduling + underlying NVMe queue depth/firmware interaction. long-term options: stagger compaction across shards, move heavy compaction to dedicated maintenance nodes, investigate NVMe firmware/queue-depth, or increase cp storage IO reservation.
infra: we'll run health checks on NVMe controllers for the impacted cp fleet and check firmware versions + SMART metrics. scheduling ASAP.
runtime-eng: runtime could implement a compaction offload that performs snapshot/compaction on a non-critical node, then swaps data back. adding to backlog.
kate: also saw elevated kv tombstone counts for this cluster; add tombstone_per_rev metric and compaction latency SLI.
meera: created follow-up ticket SRE-914 for metrics + runbook. I'll own it. includes action to randomize compaction start times across shards.
aj: action items summarized in INC-5678 and SRE backlog: 1) NVMe health + firmware audit (infra), 2) add tombstone/compaction metrics (meera), 3) implement staggered compaction schedule (sre), 4) prototype compaction offload (runtime-eng).
meera: one small tweak for controller-manager: leader-election timeout spikes during iowait. prefer not to widen TTL permanently; instead we'll add temporary leader-election logging to capture lease delays in future incidents.
aj: agreed. leave compaction throttled for now until maintenance window at 02:00 UTC when we can run deeper compaction on maintenance nodes.
oncall-ops: incident notes updated, mitigation applied, moving to monitoring for 2h before closing.
aj: tl;dr: aggressive etcd compaction hit NVMe I/O queue -> apiserver TLS/lease stalls -> controller-manager leader flips -> GPU attach retry/backpressure. short-term throttle fixed symptoms. long-term: storage firmware/queue checks + compaction scheduling changes and metrics.
meera: filing runbook steps and will post follow-up plan in INC-5678.
aj: thanks all. closing thread and moving detailed investigation to the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
